title: Peter's Restoration by the Sea of Tiberias
description: After the resurrection, Jesus reveals himself to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberias. They have fished all night without catching anything, but at Jesus' word they cast the net on the right side of the boat and catch 153 large fish without the net tearing. The disciple whom Jesus loved recognizes him, and Peter throws himself into the sea and swims to shore. By a fire they eat fish and bread together. After the meal, Jesus asks three times: "Simon, son of John, do you love me?" Peter answers yes each time, and Jesus gives him the task: "Feed my lambs", "Be shepherd to my sheep", "Feed my sheep." In this way Jesus restores Peter after his triple denial, foretells what kind of death he will glorify God with, and calls him anew: "Follow me!"

Take care of my sheep ... Feed my sheep." In this way, Jesus restores Peter after his threefold denial and calls him anew: "Follow me!"
